obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived target with finite correspondence evidence; not a proof
obernants.assumptions: Successful std allocation; exact bounded integer arithmetic; no live external dependencies
obernants.observation_scope: API outputs, errors, insertion IDs or query order; named test outcomes
obernants.operator: Universe: admitted coordinate sets and insertion/query histories paired with candidate results. Exclude any successful unknown-coordinate query, any value below all inserted lines or above their minimum, or a later ID tied with an earlier minimum. Empty coordinate construction cannot succeed; empty-line registered query cannot succeed; cap-rejected insertion cannot consume an ID.

obernants.operator: Given fixed X, an observed (x,v,id) retains all line histories where line id evaluates to v at x, every other line has value>=v, and every earlier ID has value>v. Intercepts/slopes and nonwinning lines remain ambiguous: at x=0, lines (0,2) and (7,2) both give v=2. Across several queries intersect these constraints; dominated lines remain unrecoverable.

obernants.operator: Lexicographic (value,id) ordering makes identical lines choose ID0, and crossing lines choose earlier insertion exactly at equality. Reversing the query reduction can return a dominated path candidate; exhaustive_envelopes rejects this compiled mutation.

obernants.operator: Sorting/deduplication maps [3,1,3] and [1,3] to the same domain. Raw cap checks occur before this projection, so repeated coordinates exceeding the cap still fail. Queries at unregistered points are rejected even when between registered extremes.
